widgets.markdown:
## Log cost estimator
Estimated cost of your logs in **{Currency}**, from the prices under **Parameters** (defaults: East US list prices, November 2026; yours depend on region and agreement). Pick the **Workspace** first.

Not covered: the Defender for Servers (500 MB per server per day) and Microsoft 365 E5 (5 MB per user per day) allowances, which are taken off only on the bill, so the tables they cover show higher here; the Sentinel data lake, dedicated clusters, search jobs and restores.

widgets.title: Billable GB per day, top 10 tables

widgets.markdown: Monthly = per day × 30. Retention counts the days kept beyond the free ones ({FreeRetentionDays} for Analytics, 30 for Basic and Auxiliary) at {RetentionPrice} per GB-month. Commitment tiers apply to the whole workspace's Analytics volume, whatever tables are picked.

Defender XDR tables measured in advanced hunting over the last 7 days, as if they were sent to the workspace as Analytics. The first 30 days in advanced hunting are part of the Defender licence. `estimate_data_size` runs 10–25% above the billed size, so the result is scaled by **{XdrFactor}**. Tables already streamed to the workspace show on **Current cost** too.

query.text:
// Each table on its own: estimate_data_size(*) over a union would count every other table's empty columns too.
union isfuzzy=true
    (DeviceProcessEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "DeviceProcessEvents"),
    (DeviceNetworkEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "DeviceNetworkEvents"),
    (DeviceFileEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "DeviceFileEvents"),
    (DeviceRegistryEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "DeviceRegistryEvents"),
    (DeviceLogonEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "DeviceLogonEvents"),
    (DeviceImageLoadEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "DeviceImageLoadEvents"),
    (DeviceEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "DeviceEvents"),
    (DeviceInfo | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "DeviceInfo"),
    (DeviceNetworkInfo | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "DeviceNetworkInfo"),
    (DeviceFileCertificateInfo | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "DeviceFileCertificateInfo"),
    (EmailEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "EmailEvents"),
    (EmailAttachmentInfo | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "EmailAttachmentInfo"),
    (EmailUrlInfo | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "EmailUrlInfo"),
    (EmailPostDeliveryEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "EmailPostDeliveryEvents"),
    (UrlClickEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "UrlClickEvents"),
    (IdentityLogonEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "IdentityLogonEvents"),
    (IdentityQueryEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "IdentityQueryEvents"),
    (IdentityDirectoryEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "IdentityDirectoryEvents"),
    (IdentityInfo | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "IdentityInfo"),
    (CloudAppEvents | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "CloudAppEvents"),
    (AlertInfo | where Timestamp > ago(7d) | summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(estimate_data_size(*)) | extend Table = "AlertInfo"),

| where Rows > 0
| extend GBPerDay = Bytes / 1e9 / 7 * {XdrFactor}

widgets.markdown: Estimate a table before you connect it: from **events per day** × **bytes per event** (× 0.75, as billed size is about a quarter smaller than the raw JSON), or from a **similar table** you already collect, measured on yesterday's billed size.

widgets.title: From events per day × bytes per event

query.text:
// Billed size is about 25% smaller than the raw JSON an event is sent as.
let gbPerDay = 1.0 * {EventsPerDay} * {BytesPerEvent} * 0.75 / 1e9;
datatable(Plan: string) ["Analytics", "Basic", "Auxiliary"]
| extend PricePerGB = case(Plan == "Basic", {PriceBasic}, Plan == "Auxiliary", {PriceAuxiliary}, {PriceAnalytics}), FreeDays = iff(Plan == "Analytics", {FreeRetentionDays}, 30)
| extend GBPerDay = round(gbPerDay, 3)
| extend IngestPerMonth = round(GBPerDay * 30 * PricePerGB, 2), RetentionPerMonth = round(GBPerDay * max_of(0, {RetentionDays} - FreeDays) * {RetentionPrice}, 2)
| extend TotalPerMonth = IngestPerMonth + RetentionPerMonth
| project Plan, GBPerDay, PricePerGB, IngestPerMonth, RetentionPerMonth, TotalPerMonth

// Yesterday's billed bytes per row of the similar table. Scanning a Basic or Auxiliary table is billed, so pick an Analytics one.
let measured = table({SimilarTable})
| where TimeGenerated between (startofday(ago(1d)) .. startofday(now()))
| summarize Rows = count(), Bytes = sum(_BilledSize)
| extend BytesPerRow = iff(Rows == 0, real(null), 1.0 * Bytes / Rows), k = 1;
datatable(Plan: string) ["Analytics", "Basic", "Auxiliary"]
| extend PricePerGB = case(Plan == "Basic", {PriceBasic}, Plan == "Auxiliary", {PriceAuxiliary}, {PriceAnalytics}), FreeDays = iff(Plan == "Analytics", {FreeRetentionDays}, 30)
| extend k = 1
| join kind=inner measured on k
| extend GBPerDay = round({EventsPerDay} * BytesPerRow / 1e9, 3), BytesPerRow = round(BytesPerRow, 1)
| extend IngestPerMonth = round(GBPerDay * 30 * PricePerGB, 2), RetentionPerMonth = round(GBPerDay * max_of(0, {RetentionDays} - FreeDays) * {RetentionPrice}, 2)
| extend TotalPerMonth = IngestPerMonth + RetentionPerMonth
| project Plan, BytesPerRow, GBPerDay, PricePerGB, IngestPerMonth, RetentionPerMonth, TotalPerMonth
